scope: Exercise same-version raw-carrier insertion of omitted SectionViewStyle group-1 handles.
Verify null placeholders for omitted identifier-style and arrow-start handles when arrow-end alone is edited.
Check emitted-handle remapping, exact ordered raw-style streams, reference closure, and following-record continuity.

implementation.behavior: No production behavior changed. The generated callback-storage test removes all three SectionViewStyle group-1 references, imports their zero defaults, edits only arrow-end to reference the existing VIEW_STYLE_ARROW block record, then verifies that output retains null identifier/style and arrow-start slots before the remapped arrow-end reference.
testCases: Run the missing-handle case in ASCII and Binary DXF.
Assert typed readback, remapped arrow-end target, exact raw DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle collections, closed resource references, and intact following POINT sentinel.

limitations: The slice verifies same-version DXF carrier insertion and reference closure only; it does not qualify DWG-origin serialization, cross-version projection, or native style rendering.
The worktree is broadly dirty and remains uncommitted; no staging or cleanup of unrelated user changes was performed.
